plugins.name: mokaru
plugins.description: Search jobs, tailor your resume to a specific role with AI, track applications, and manage your resume content through your Mokaru account.

skills.name: application-tracker
skills.description: Manages the user's job application pipeline in Mokaru - saving jobs, updating status, reviewing what stage each application is at, and tracking contacts. Use when the user asks about applications they sent, interview stages, follow-ups, or their job search pipeline.

skills.name: job-search
skills.description: Searches the Mokaru job database and presents matches with apply links. Use when the user is looking for jobs, vacancies, or roles, or asks what is open in a location, industry, or work arrangement.
headings: This plugin does not apply for the user

skills.name: resume-content
skills.description: Reads and edits the content of a Mokaru resume - experience, education, skills, certificates, projects, awards, publications, interests, summaries, and custom sections. Use when the user wants to add, correct, or remove something on their CV or career profile.
headings: Item ids come from the list tools only

skills.name: tailor-resume
skills.description: Tailors a Mokaru resume to a specific job with AI, producing a job-specific copy without touching the base resume. Use when the user wants their CV rewritten, optimized, or matched for a particular role or job posting.
headings: Tailoring a resume to a job
